mission.goal: Create comprehensive test suite for ExecutionEngine timeout and recovery features
mission.description: Implement unit tests, integration tests, and documentation for the timeout/recovery mechanisms in ExecutionEngine. This validates the existing E10.1 timeout implementation.
mission.objective: Production-ready test coverage for: 1) task timeout behavior, 2) sandbox cleanup on timeout, 3) checkpoint/resume with timeout, 4) failure recovery
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests for Task timeout field
Test for sandbox cleanup on timeout
Test for checkpoint/resume with timeout state
